plain: A UFO researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb told podcast host Jesse Michels about a story from Italy in 1933 tied to a man named Marone. He says Marone's grandson may be close to speaking out, and that an Italian UFO researcher named Penotti is hot on that trail. If the grandson talks, it could shed new light on what is said to have happened in Italy back then.
